sites_coordinates_check.name: sites_coordinates_check
sites_coordinates_check.value:
("sites"."latitude" is null) = ("sites"."longitude" is null)
        and ("sites"."latitude" is null or "sites"."latitude" between -90 and 90)
        and ("sites"."longitude" is null or "sites"."longitude" between -180 and 180)

routers_credentials_check.name: routers_credentials_check
routers_credentials_check.value: "routers"."status" = 'PROVISIONING' or ("routers"."routeros_username" is not null and "routers"."routeros_password_encrypted" is not null)

alerts_acknowledged_check.name: alerts_acknowledged_check
alerts_acknowledged_check.value: "alerts"."acknowledged_by" is null or "alerts"."acknowledged_at" is not null

hotspots_network_check.name: hotspots_network_check
hotspots_network_check.value:
family("hotspots"."gateway_address") = 4 and masklen("hotspots"."gateway_address") between 16 and 30
        and "hotspots"."pool_start" << network("hotspots"."gateway_address") and "hotspots"."pool_end" << network("hotspots"."gateway_address")
        and "hotspots"."pool_start" <= "hotspots"."pool_end"
        and not (host("hotspots"."gateway_address")::inet between "hotspots"."pool_start" and "hotspots"."pool_end")

plans_limits_check.name: plans_limits_check
plans_limits_check.value: "plans"."validity_seconds" is not null or "plans"."session_time_seconds" is not null or "plans"."data_quota_bytes" is not null

plans_values_check.name: plans_values_check
plans_values_check.value:
("plans"."validity_seconds" is null or "plans"."validity_seconds" between 60 and 31622400)
        and ("plans"."session_time_seconds" is null or "plans"."session_time_seconds" between 60 and 31622400)
        and ("plans"."rate_up_kbps" is null or "plans"."rate_up_kbps" between 8 and 10000000)
        and ("plans"."rate_down_kbps" is null or "plans"."rate_down_kbps" between 8 and 10000000)
        and ("plans"."data_quota_bytes" is null or "plans"."data_quota_bytes" between 1048576 and 109951162777600)
        and "plans"."max_devices" between 1 and 10
        and "plans"."idle_timeout_seconds" between 60 and 86400

voucher_batches_label_check.name: voucher_batches_label_check
voucher_batches_label_check.value: "voucher_batches"."label" is null or char_length("voucher_batches"."label") between 1 and 80
